description: This file defines a class 'Financial' which provides a set of financial calculation functions, many of which are deprecated and redirect to specific classes within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace. It includes various financial, depreciation, security, and interest rate methods used for spreadsheet computations.

classes.name: Financial
classes.description: A utility class providing access to various deprecated financial calculation functions, primarily forwarding calls to specific calculation classes and methods within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: ACCRINT
methods.description: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest by delegating to Securities\AccruedInterest::periodic.

methods.name: ACCRINTM
methods.description: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity by delegating to Securities\AccruedInterest::atMaturity.

methods.name: AMORDEGRC
methods.description: Returns depreciation using the AMORDEGRC method, delegating to Amortization::AMORDEGRC.

methods.name: AMORLINC
methods.description: Returns depreciation using the AMORLINC method, delegating to Amortization::AMORLINC.

methods.name: COUPDAYBS
methods.description: Returns the number of days from the beginning of a coupon period to settlement, delegating to Coupons::COUPDAYBS.

methods.name: COUPDAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the coupon period, delegating to Coupons::COUPDAYS.

methods.name: COUPDAYSNC
methods.description: Returns the number of days from settlement to the next coupon date, delegating to Coupons::COUPDAYSNC.

methods.name: COUPNCD
methods.description: Returns the next coupon date after settlement, delegating to Coupons::COUPNCD.

methods.name: COUPNUM
methods.description: Returns the number of coupons payable, delegating to Coupons::COUPNUM.

methods.name: COUPPCD
methods.description: Returns the previous coupon date before settlement, delegating to Coupons::COUPPCD.

methods.name: CUMIPMT
methods.description: Returns cumulative interest paid between periods, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Cumulative::interest.

methods.name: CUMPRINC
methods.description: Returns cumulative principal paid between periods, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Cumulative::principal.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Returns depreciation using the fixed-declining balance method, delegating to Depreciation::DB.

methods.name: DDB
methods.description: Returns depreciation using double-declining balance, delegating to Depreciation::DDB.

methods.name: DISC
methods.description: Returns the discount rate for a security, delegating to Financial\Securities\Rates::discount.

methods.name: DOLLARDE
methods.description: Converts fractional dollar price into decimal, delegating to Dollar::decimal.

methods.name: DOLLARFR
methods.description: Converts decimal dollar price into fractional, delegating to Dollar::fractional.

methods.name: EFFECT
methods.description: Returns effective interest rate given nominal rate, delegating to Financial\InterestRate::effective.

methods.name: FV
methods.description: Calculates future value of an annuity or cash flow, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic::futureValue.

methods.name: FVSCHEDULE
methods.description: Returns future value of an initial amount with varying interest rates, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Single::futureValue.

methods.name: INTRATE
methods.description: Returns the interest rate for a security, delegating to Financial\Securities\Rates::interest.

methods.name: IPMT
methods.description: Returns interest payment for a specific period, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Interest::payment.

methods.name: IRR
methods.description: Returns internal rate of return for a series of cash flows, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\Periodic::rate.

methods.name: ISPMT
methods.description: Returns interest payment for a schedule, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Interest::schedulePayment.

methods.name: MIRR
methods.description: Returns modified internal rate of return, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\Periodic::modifiedRate.

methods.name: NOMINAL
methods.description: Returns nominal interest rate from effective rate, delegating to Financial\InterestRate::nominal.

methods.name: NPER
methods.description: Returns total number of periods, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic::periods.

methods.name: NPV
methods.description: Returns net present value, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\Periodic::presentValue.

methods.name: PDURATION
methods.description: Returns number of periods to reach a future value, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Single::periods.

methods.name: PMT
methods.description: Returns constant payment for an annuity, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Payments::annuity.

methods.name: PPMT
methods.description: Returns principal payment for a specific period, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Payments::interestPayment.

methods.name: PRICE
methods.description: Calculates price of a security, delegating to Securities\Price::price.

methods.name: PRICEDISC
methods.description: Calculates discounted security price, delegating to Securities\Price::priceDiscounted.

methods.name: PRICEMAT
methods.description: Calculates price at maturity, delegating to Securities\Price::priceAtMaturity.

methods.name: PV
methods.description: Calculates present value of a cash flow, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic::presentValue.

methods.name: RATE
methods.description: Calculates interest rate per period, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Interest::rate.

methods.name: RECEIVED
methods.description: Returns amount received at maturity, delegating to Securities\Price::received.

methods.name: RRI
methods.description: Calculates interest rate to reach future value, delegating to Financial\CashFlow\Single::interestRate.

methods.name: SLN
methods.description: Straight-line depreciation, delegating to Depreciation::SLN.

methods.name: SYD
methods.description: Sum-of-years' digits depreciation, delegating to Depreciation::SYD.

methods.name: TBILLEQ
methods.description: Bond-equivalent yield for Treasury bill, delegating to TreasuryBill::bondEquivalentYield.

methods.name: TBILLPRICE
methods.description: Price of Treasury bill, delegating to TreasuryBill::price.

methods.name: TBILLYIELD
methods.description: Yield of Treasury bill, delegating to TreasuryBill::yield.

methods.name: XIRR
methods.description: IRR for non-periodic cash flows, delegating to CashFlow\Variable\NonPeriodic::rate.

methods.name: XNPV
methods.description: Net present value for non-periodic cash flows, delegating to CashFlow\Variable\NonPeriodic::presentValue.

methods.name: YIELDDISC
methods.description: Yield of discounted security, delegating to Securities\Yields::yieldDiscounted.

methods.name: YIELDMAT
methods.description: Yield at maturity, delegating to Securities\Yields::yieldAtMaturity.
